author: More Perfect Union
description:
Elon Musk's Grok is a military weapon, and xAI is above environmental laws — according to the Trump administration.

The NAACP sued xAI for polluting Memphis, but the Department of Justice argues that since Grok helped the U.S. bomb Iran the lawsuit should be dismissed.

Producer: @samuelpotterblack
Editor: David McCaw
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: Trump's DOJ says Memphis residents can't sue xAI because Grok helped the U.S. bomb Iran

author: More Perfect Union
description:
$100 million went missing from an online bank.

"Neobanks" promise higher rates and lower fees, but they exist in a regulatory black box created by Andreessen, Thiel, Musk and more.

We investigated an online bank where thousands of Americans' FDIC-insured savings vanished.

Host & Producer: Sanya Dosani
Video Editor: Anthony Mascorro
Motion Designer: Tom Van Deusen
Videographers: Jack Belisle, Ryan Goble, Timothy Wolfer
Video Production Manager: Isabel Atalaya

Video Production Fellow: Astrid Dong
Video Editing Fellow: Daria Nastasia
Supervising Producer: Brady Welch

description: Watch Jacob Rockwell, a man fined for running a red light in Florida while being in Alabama, pop off against the use of the A.I. red light cameras that were used to "identify" him.
title: Jacob Rockwell was fined by an AI red light camera in a different state

author: More Perfect Union
description:
Today is Primary Day in New York, where Claire Valdez is part of a new wave of candidates running to change that by electing working class candidates instead of millionaires.

Claire has worked at Taco Bell, Pizza Hut, and Trader Joe's — now she's running for Congress in NY-7.

Just 2% of Congress has worked these low-wage jobs.


Producer: Meagan Day
Narrator: @discosludge
Editor: Chris Osborn
Videographer: Desta Mutisya
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: Can This Former Taco Bell Worker Make It All the Way to Congress?
